title: Chapter 788
text:
The main goal of this trip to the Central Galaxy was to meet the upper echelons of the dynasty, enter the circle of the dynasty's allies, and officially step onto the stage of the Central Galaxy from the Shattered Star Ring.

Other than that, Han Xiao had two other important goals.

The first was to try to obtain Ultimate Knowledges from the dynasty.

The dynasty had generously given him all the Cutting-Edge Knowledges of the Mechanic class, but the value of Ultimate Knowledges was even higher. Even Beyond Grade A allies had to make a certain amount of contributions to obtain them. The dynasty being willing to give him all the Cutting-Edge Knowledges at once was generous, but keeping the Ultimate Knowledges was a rule.

The status of a Beyond Grade A ally in a Universal Civilization was similar to a consecration, and the resources were not given for free. Han Xiao estimated that he would only be able to apply for Ultimate Knowledges after he finished exploring the Flickering World. He wanted to go to the Central Galaxy and see if he could obtain them earlier.

Due to the experience penalty from the Evolution Cube, his strength had temporarily reached a bottleneck. Han Xiao was prepared to look for other ways to increase his strength like the other Beyond Grade As.

Other than talents, blueprints, and skills, there were Class Knowledges. The rarer something was, the more valuable it was. Ultimate Knowledges greatly increased the strength of any class.

The highest he had was only Cutting-Edge Knowledges, and his [King's Mentor] ability required Ultimate Knowledges to activate.

His second goal was to develop his leek farm.

The Shattered Star Ring was only the region of a portion of the players. There were also a large number of players in the other Star Fields. In the past, due to the distance and the army's insufficient strength, Han Xiao could not help them.

Now that he had the opportunity to borrow the Red Empire's military cross-Star Field channel, he could bring his people to develop new leek farms in the dynasty's territory.

This way, the fame he had accumulated among the players over the past three versions would come in handy. The name of the Black Star Corps was also attractive to the players of the other Star Fields. The players of the Shattered Star Ring were the best example.

He might be able to bring some of the Central Galaxy's players back and take the leek seedlings of others back to his own farm!

Han Xiao's lips curled up.

"This time, I might be gone for two to three months and will return before the Flickering World officially opens. During this time, I'll leave the matters of the army to you guys."

"It's all thanks to you bringing back so many allies from the Shattered Star Ring. Our partners are all over this Star Field, and the expansion of the army is coming to an end. As long as we digest these gains according to the plan, we will stabilize. You don't have to worry."

Sylvia had a serious expression.

"I'm not worried about you guys." Han Xiao smiled and nodded.

After a series of operations, the Black Star Corps had officially transformed into a Beyond Grade A organization and become a giant in the Shattered Star Ring. Their network of interests covered the entire Star Field. According to the established blueprint, more than ten thousand sub-bases would be built one after another, distributed in more than ten Star Clusters and many Star Systems in the Shattered Star Ring.

The expansion of their businesses was also very smooth. Through the channels provided by their partners in various industries, they had officially stepped into many business areas. The new businesses included financial group trading, intelligence selling, tourism transportation, machinery production, and so on. The core businesses were still the three main businesses: mercenary business, resource mining business, and military alliance business. These three were the pillars of the army.

Among the many businesses, the only one that could not be replicated was the benefits brought by the Evolution Cube. There was only one Evolution Cube, so it naturally became the specialty of the Black Star Corps. It was because of this that the expansion of the Black Star Army had been so smooth. They had always been successful.

The Evolution Cube was also open to the members of the army and required Contribution Points to exchange for the right to use it. It was because of this specialty that the army attracted far more newcomers than expected, which laid the foundation for the large-scale expansion of the army.

With the Tyrant's ceasefire and Sisko's surrender, there was no organization in this area that could threaten the army's position.

It could be said that the Shattered Star Ring had become the headquarters of the Black Star Corps. The army had established a strong foundation here, and the next step was to open up a new market.

"I will take some of the Black Star Guards with me. The high-level combatants here will be handled by Deputy Commander Lagi. Don't let him slack off …"

Han Xiao suddenly thought of something and added, "Also, announce to the entire army that I have been invited to the Red Empire."

"No problem." Sylvia did not ask why.

Since he was going to open up a new market, Han Xiao did not plan to let go of the players' information channels. He could release the information through the forums to let the players in the Central Galaxy be mentally prepared.

Anyway, the army players were like free spammers, so it would be a waste not to use them.

Leaving the headquarters this time, Han Xiao was not afraid of others causing trouble. The Tyrant had become an ally, and they had established a ceasefire agreement. Causing trouble would not benefit him.

Sisko also temporarily stopped. Han Xiao had obtained political protection through the Blue Star Civilization Conference seat. If Sisko attacked the army while he was not around, it would be breaking the rules. Furthermore, Sisko had his own race to take care of, so he would not dare act rashly.

Furthermore, the current situation was different from when he was with Sisko. The Evolution Cube was now with Han Xiao, and if he wanted it, he could only snatch it. Thus, attacking the Black Star Corps was meaningless. It was the same for EsGod.

As for enemies below the Beyond Grade A level, Han Xiao was even less worried. With so many Calamity Grade officers in the army, anyone who dared to cause trouble was simply looking for trouble.

…

After resting for two days, the fleet heading to the Central Galaxy officially gathered.

Today was the day they set off.

The fleet consisted of 3,500 battleships, and the main ships were three satellite bases. Although the satellite bases were bulky, they were also equipped with hyperdrive devices. It was just that their warp speed was not high.

Han Xiao did not mass-produce the Eternal Light flagship. As an ally of the Red Empire, using the Radiant Federation's flagship was too ostentatious. Han Xiao treated it as a secret weapon, secretly building it and storing it in the warehouse. He did not plan to use it publicly for the time being.

Teny and the other elites of the dynasty were invited by Han Xiao to board the same battleship.

In the command room, all the members were in position, staring at Han Xiao's back, waiting for orders.

In front of the huge porthole, Han Xiao and Ames stood side by side, looking at the sea of stars outside.

The light from the thrusters of the surrounding battleships shone on their faces, leaving behind mottled shadows.

"Are you sure you want to go?"

"It's not like I haven't been to the Central Galaxy before." Ames smiled. "I'll just treat it as a vacation."

Aesop stroked his beard and said, "Just nice, I'll go back and visit my old friends."

Han Xiao nodded, retracted his gaze, and spoke with a deep voice. His voice sounded in the communication channel, spreading to every battleship.

"Let's go."

Rumble!

The hull trembled slightly, and it began to accelerate, leaving the Black Star Corps headquarters.

The surrounding spaceships followed one after another, and the fleet set off.

Very soon, the spaceships turned into streams of light, disappearing into the dark universe.

…

When the fleet set off, countless army members watched from the headquarters' satellites.

Sylvia followed Han Xiao's instructions and announced Han Xiao's whereabouts to the entire army. Everyone knew that the army commander had received an invitation from the Red Empire to meet the dynasty's leader.

That was the leader of the three Universal Civilizations, the person with the highest status in this universe!

Countless army members were excited and proud. The army players became active on the forums, full of surprise. Black Star was the first person they were familiar with to cross servers!

This news ignited the passion of the players in the various Star Fields.

All along, the Shattered Star Ring had enjoyed the benefits of the Black Star Corps, and the players in the other Star Fields were envious.

With so many deeds of the Black Star Corps circulating on the forums, and the recent news of Han Xiao becoming a Beyond Grade A Super had caused a huge commotion. The benefits of the army had long been known to the players in the various Star Fields. In comparison, the players in the other Star Fields realized that the benefits of their factions were not worth mentioning at all.

Now, the chance to come into contact with the Black Star Corps had arrived!

The players in the Central Galaxy were overjoyed, and this topic blew up their forums.

"The Black Star Corps is finally going to cross Star Fields?"

"Haha, that's great. We also have the chance to join the Black Star Corps."

"Sigh, what a pity. If only we came to the Primeval Star River."

The players in the Shattered Star Ring did not have any other thoughts. The better the Black Star Corps developed, the more proud they would be. At the same time, they felt that it was refreshing. Perhaps the army commander would bring the players from the other Star Fields back?

To the players at the current stage, crossing Star Fields was too difficult. They did not have the qualifications to use the stargates to cross Star Fields, and they could not afford spaceships that could travel at high warp speeds. Furthermore, they had not even finished exploring the Star Field they were born in.

The players of the various Star Fields were currently playing their own games. They would only interact with each other in the professional arena. Normally, they wouldn't meet at all.

"Maybe the Black Star Corps will be the faction that guides us to cross Star Fields in the future?"

"The possibility is very high. Now that the army has become allies with a Universal Civilization, and the next step is to explore the Flickering World, it's like opening the era of crossing Star Fields for us."

There were many different opinions on the forums.

…

At the same time, in Bloodshed Land …

"Black Star has set off?"

"Yes, just now."

Heber sat on the throne with his fist supporting the side of his face. He looked in the direction of the palace gate and aimlessly looked into the distance.

As an ally of the Red Empire, he had been to the Red Empire a long time ago and had received an invitation like Han Xiao.

His gaze seemed to have passed through the vast universe, and an indescribable emotion flashed through Heber's eyes. He seemed to have recalled some memories.

"Those guys in the Central Galaxy … are not so friendly."

…

Central Galaxy, Red Empire's mother planet.

Tarunamir Palace was where the dynasty's government affairs were conducted. Including the dynasty's leader, the core upper echelons were all there. It was extremely large and was a city of its own on the mother planet.

This was the center of the dynasty's power. It was solemn and heavily guarded, and almost none of the government officials spoke.

Two people, one tall and one short, walked side by side in a long corridor in Tarunamir Palace. The warm light shone in from the windows on the left, and their shadows were reflected on the wall.

When the government officials saw the two of them, they all showed respect and stood where they were, bowing their heads to show their respect.

"I've gathered you this time to meet the new ally."

"I think his name is Black Star?"

"Yes, he came from the Shattered Star Ring and only became a Beyond Grade A recently."

"Oh, a new Beyond Grade A from the Shattered Star Ring … I can't remember when was the last time a new Beyond Grade A was born there."

"I can't remember either."

"Isn't that Heber also from the Shattered Star Ring? Is he coming this time?"

"I don't think so."

"Sigh, that's boring …"

"Not necessarily. According to the data, this new ally is the fastest Super to become a Beyond Grade A in history. His combat strength is not low. Heber and Sisko both fought him to a draw. Furthermore, he has the nickname 'Indestructible Body'. Although he's a Mechanic, his body is extremely tough."

"Oh? Now that's interesting. I wonder who is more resilient between him and Heber. "

The two of them chatted casually and walked further and further away.
